title: NPS discarded the request (Event 6274)
plain_english: Event 6274 means NPS did not evaluate the request at all: it could not parse or verify the packet, or it arrived in a state NPS refuses to process. The decisive detail is the Reason Code line. If a more specific diagnosis appears above this one, that is your answer; if this generic result is all you got, the pasted text is probably missing the Reason Code / Reason lines.

any: Network Policy Server discarded the request

causes.cause: Most 6274 events are a shared-secret mismatch reported as a malformed packet (Reason Code 3) or an unverified signature (Reason Code 262).
causes.next_check: Read the Reason Code line; re-enter the shared secret on both the NAS and the RADIUS Client entry.

causes.cause: The pasted event text is incomplete.
causes.next_check: In Event Viewer, right-click the 6274 event > 'Copy details as text' and paste the whole event including the Authentication Details section.
